correctness.rationale: For 1<r<3 the dual cube-hyperplane section has exactly twelve explicitly enumerated extreme functionals. The two exact functional decompositions give operator-norm domination constants K_L=(-r^2+5r-2)/(r+1) and K_H=min((3r-1)/(r(3-r)),3/r); two explicit rank-one maps attain each constant. Their comparison gives all three pieces, with direct endpoint arguments. The embedded rational checker verifies 359 distinct parameters, including both functional identities and sharp norm/radius witnesses; finite tests are corroboration rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Completes the natural one-edge deformation of a four-point cycle, revealing two exact active-facet transitions, an unexpected strict interior minimum 5/9 at r=5/3, and explicit extremal rank-one maps. Neither the threshold n=1 at r=1 and r=3 nor the previously known short-edge formula predicts this nonmonotone law. The index is a natural isometric Banach-space invariant, not an arbitrary statistic.
